title: DeathWay
body:
# DeathWay
Required Plugin: https://modrinth.com/plugin/kotlinplugins
- Allows to personalize the death of player by choosing the reason behind it.   
- Usage: ```/death <ClickTabToAutoCompleteTheReasonOfDeath <nickname>```
- Required permission to use this command: ```deathway.death```
- Players with op (/op nickname) have this required permission by default.
- The purpose of this plugin is to surprise players if well used. 

- Check out other plugins: https://modrinth.com/user/Winlyps
